biggest_catch: The referred friend must open the account in person at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch in Iowa, with a minimum $500 opening balance, and keep it open 90 days — the bonus only pays after ~90 days.
catches: Friend must be a new customer who opens a checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch with a minimum $500 opening balance.
The new account must establish a recurring or direct deposit, include checks and/or a debit card, and remain open for a minimum of 90 days.
The referring customer must have an active GCSB account.
Cap: up to $500 in referral bonuses per calendar year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Guthrie County State Bank's official page (gcsbank.com/referral/) runs a Refer A Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns $50 for each qualifying friend, up to $500 per calendar year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the referring customer shares GCSB with a friend; the friend opens a new checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch, mentioning the referrer's name, with a minimum $500 opening balance; the new account must establish a recurring or direct deposit, include checks and/or a debit card, and remain open for at least 90 days.

c4.evidence: Timing: both the referrer and the new customer receive the $50 bonus credited to their accounts approximately 90 days after the new account's opening, provided all requirements are met.

eligibility: GCSB customers with an active account referring new customers; new customer opens a checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch.
notes: Guthrie County State Bank is an Iowa community bank. The bank reserves the right to modify or discontinue the program at any time.
payout_quote: $50 for you, $50 for a friend... You could earn $500 a year, just for spreading the word about the benefits of local banking you trust. Refer up to 10 friends a year.
payout_value_note: $50 bonus credited to the referrer's account.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: up to $500 per calendar year.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date is published.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: tell a friend to switch to GCSB; friend opens a new checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch, mentioning the referrer's name.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: be a new customer; open a new checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch with a minimum $500 opening balance; establish a recurring or direct deposit; include checks and/or a debit card; keep the account open a minimum of 90 days.

steps: Tell a friend about Guthrie County State Bank.
Friend opens a new checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch with a $500+ opening balance, mentioning your name.
Friend sets up a recurring/direct deposit and keeps the account open 90 days.
You receive $50 credited to your account ~90 days after the new account opening, up to $500 per calendar year.
timing: Both parties receive the $50 bonus credited to their accounts approximately 90 days after the new account's opening.
